name: DemoApp
audience: English-speaking adults (18–40) who want a calm evening routine

look.character: a woman in her late 20s with shoulder-length dark wavy hair, oatmeal knit sweater, no jewellery
look.setting: a cosy apartment living room with a wooden table, plants and a warm floor lamp
look.lighting: golden-hour window light turning into warm lamp light

scripts.caption: Three lines a night. That's the whole habit. #journaling #nightroutine #DemoApp

hooks.visual: Close-up: the main character drops onto the sofa, exhales and rubs her eyes; the evening city glows outside the window.
hooks.voiceover: Does every day feel exactly the same?

hooks.visual: The main character walks in, switches on a warm floor lamp and smiles at a blank notebook waiting on the table.
hooks.voiceover: Here's a two-minute habit for tonight.

shots.visual: Side view: the main character writes three short lines in the notebook (page never visible), then sets the pen down and smiles calmly.
shots.voiceover: Open DemoApp, write three lines and pick your mood. Small notes that keep your days from blurring. Try DemoApp.
